verdict.rationale: GitLab's homepage claims agents can 'remediate vulnerabilities' (gitlab-docs-1). Its scanners (SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, DAST) surface findings in merge requests (gitlab-docs-29), and the Duo Agent Platform lets users delegate security tasks to AI agents (gitlab-docs-47). However, the evidence is only marketing-level statements, with no documentation of how fixes are generated and applied. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the AI vulnerability-resolution flow (fix generation, auto-created fix merge requests, supported scanner/finding types), evidence of automatic application versus human approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
